entries.name: Windows Console (legacy mode)
entries.message: A console in legacy mode does not paste on Ctrl+V, so long text is typed instead.

entries.name: mintty (Git Bash, Cygwin, MSYS2)
entries.message: mintty pastes on Shift+Insert, not Ctrl+V, so long text is typed instead.

entries.name: PuTTY
entries.message: PuTTY pastes on right-click or Shift+Insert, not Ctrl+V, so long text is typed instead.

entries.name: Remote Desktop Connection
entries.message: The remote session only sees this PC's clipboard when clipboard redirection is on, so long text is typed instead.
